scope: Repository-local active bundle and portable mirror only
notes: The official installer helper staged the pinned public skill into a temporary directory using Git after local Python certificate-chain validation blocked its download method.
The official validator initially encountered the sandbox-protected default uv cache; the successful run used a temporary cache and did not synchronize the project environment.
This validates skill structure, mirror equality and recorded import integrity. It is not an Impeccable native engine audit or live retrieval test.
